name: function-usage-detector
description: Report functions shorter than a line threshold or with fewer than a call-site threshold

scripts.test: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/codemod.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 workflow validate -w workflow.yaml
scripts.validate-package: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 ai call validate_codemod_package --input '{"package_path":"."}'
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm check-types && pnpm validate && pnpm validate-package
